main_text.p: quemadmodum vicarius Trajani Im-peratoris vices gerebat sui Imperatoris. Et sic ministros non habere suam potestatem à Christo, sed à Magistratu, qui & quidem solus eam potestatem immediatè à Christo acceperit. Adeoque Magistratum in locum Papę constituebant, imò plus ei tribuebant, quam Romanenses Pon-tifici. Gubernationem etiam Ecclesiæ assignabant sòli Magistratui; ab eâ excludentes Ministros, nisi in quantum essent vicarii & instrumen-ta seu servi Magistratus. Speciatim electionem ministrorum seu voca-tionem, item depositionem tribue-bant solì Magistratui, & quidem non solùm summo, sed etiam subalternis Magistratibus, qui oppidatim vices gerunt summi Magistratus; statue-bantque penes eos esse distribuere officia Ecclesiastica, non secus atq;in ipsorum potestate est distribuere of-ficia Politica. Contendebant etiā ad solum Magistratum immediatè sub Chri-

page.notes: The small dark marks at the edges of the text block and in the right margin are scan specks and show-through, not printed notes. The printed text ends with the word "Chri-" on the last line, which is a line-end hyphenation, so it is kept in the paragraph and not treated as a catchword. The "Digitised by Google" line at the bottom right is the digitiser's banner and is left out. The "Papę" and "etiā" forms are copied as printed. The word "assignabant" is printed with a spaced ligature and is read as "assignabant", but the spacing is uncertain.
